A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully developed a novel adenovirus variant that can be used as a platform for the incorporation of heterologous reporter genes into protein IX.
we have demonstrated the feasibility of using MT to radiolabel Ad vectors and that the biodistribution is similar to that of Ad vectors without MT fusion proteins.
we have successfully incorporated human metallothionein into protein IX and have shown that this fusion protein can be radiolabeled with 99mTec.
The main takeaway from our work is that
this is the first study to demonstrate in vivo imaging of an Ad vector that incorporates a low-molecular-mass protein.
the pIX-MT construct can be used to track Ad biodistribution and that the MT fusion is an effective way to radiolabel the Ad.
the pIX-MT platform is a promising strategy to track adenovirus in vivo, and the results from this work can guide future studies to optimize the platform.
